title: The Impact of Exogenous Pollution on Green Innovation
Discretionary Exemptions from Environmental Regulation: Flexibility for Good or for Ill
abstract: Many environmental regulations impose limits on harmful activities yet include discretionary “safety valve” provisions allowing the regulator to grant exemptions that provide relief to regulated parties. We construct a theoretical model and explore cases in which this discretion serves good or ill. We show that when a regulation is otherwise inflexible, exemptions can improve social welfare, and perhaps reduce pollution, by distributing abatement more cost-effectively across polluters. However, these beneficial predictions rely on an unconstrained, fully informed, and benevolent regulator. In other cases, exemptions may not offer such gains; further, the discretionary nature of exemptions allows them to be abused.
abstract_zh: 许多环境法规对有害活动施加了限制，但同时包含一些可自由裁量的“安全阀”条款，允许监管机构批准豁免，以减轻受规管方的负担。我们构建了一个理论模型，探讨这种自由裁量权在何种情形下有益、又在何种情形下有害。我们表明，当某项法规本身缺乏灵活性时，豁免可以通过在污染者之间更具成本效益地分配减排任务，从而改善社会福利，甚至可能减少污染。然而，这些有益的预测依赖于一个不受约束、掌握充分信息且秉持善意的监管者。在其他情形下，豁免可能无法带来此类收益；此外，豁免的自由裁量性质也使其可能被滥用。

title: Understanding why farmers adopt soil conservation tillage: A systematic review
abstract: As soils across the globe continue to face problems of severe degradation and loss under current management practices, there is a great need to study soil conservation decisions such as conservation tillage (CST). In this paper, we consider the question of why farmers do and do not adopt CST by taking into account a wide variety of factors that impact farmers. Based on the literature, we argue that seven key factors enter the farmer's decision problem. These factors include farmers’ perceptions about soil health, risk, soil stewardship, the impact of adoption on profits, government payments, yield, and future access to land. We then review the literature to examine what has been learned about each of these factors. This sheds light on what we know about why farmers adopt CST, and what we do not know, thus identifying important areas for future research.
abstract_zh: 在当前管理实践下，全球土壤持续面临严重退化和流失的问题，因此迫切需要研究保护性耕作（CST）等土壤保护决策。本文考虑了一个问题：农民为何采用或不采用保护性耕作，并纳入了影响农民的各种因素。基于现有文献，我们认为有七个关键因素进入农民的决策问题。这些因素包括农民对土壤健康的认知、风险、土壤管理责任感、采用该措施对利润的影响、政府补贴、产量，以及未来获取土地的可能性。随后，我们回顾文献，考察关于上述每一因素已有的认识。这有助于厘清我们对农民为何采用保护性耕作已知与未知的部分，从而确定未来研究的重要方向。

title: Has Carbon Emissions Trading Reduced PM 2.5 in China?
abstract: China today has an urgent need to develop low-carbon policies that also address local air pollution. This study uses a difference-in-differences model to estimate the extent to which China’s Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS), which directly addresses CO 2 emissions, has also generated cobenefits by reducing PM 2.5 . Using monthly PM 2.5 concentration and weather data for 297 Chinese cities from January 2005 to December 2017, we find that (1) China’s ETS has reduced PM 2.5 concentrations by 4.8%, and this reduction effect is strongest in summer. The results are confirmed by robustness tests including propensity score matching, mahalanobis distance matching, two placebo tests, and controlling atmospheric policies. (2) The ETS pilots have positive spillovers on neighboring nonpilot cities within 300 km of the pilot cites, especially for those downwind neighboring nonpilot cities, and the ETS’s cobenefits are primarily a result of firms adopting abatement activities and adjusting industrial structure. (3) The cobenefits of China’s ETS pilots are greater in regions with larger carbon trading volume and higher carbon trading price. (4) The reduction in PM 2.5 concentration caused by China’s ETS may have avoided 23,363 deaths and saved $41.38 billion annually in GDP.
abstract_zh: 中国当前迫切需要制定既能应对地方空气污染，又能实现低碳目标的政策。本研究采用双重差分模型，估计中国碳排放交易体系（ETS）在多大程度上通过减少PM2.5产生了协同效益。该体系直接针对二氧化碳（CO2）排放。我们利用2005年1月至2017年12月中国297个城市的月度PM2.5浓度与气象数据，发现：（1）中国碳排放交易体系使PM2.5浓度降低了4.8%，且该降低效应在夏季最为显著。这一结果经过了一系列稳健性检验的证实，包括倾向得分匹配、马氏距离匹配、两项安慰剂检验，以及对大气污染政策的控制。（2）碳排放交易试点对距试点城市300公里以内的邻近非试点城市具有正向溢出效应，对于位于下风向的邻近非试点城市尤为明显；碳排放交易体系的协同效益主要源于企业采取减排活动和调整产业结构。（3）在碳交易量较大、碳交易价格较高的地区，中国碳排放交易试点的协同效益更大。（4）中国碳排放交易体系导致的PM2.5浓度下降，每年可能避免23,363例死亡，并每年节约413.8亿美元的GDP损失。

title: Developing Precautionary Reference Points for Fishery Management Using Robust Control Theory: Application to the Chesapeake Bay Blue Crab Callinectes sapidus Fishery
abstract: Most efforts to establish precautionary guidelines for fisheries management use essentially ad hoc impressions as to what constitutes conservative management. Such approaches, however, fail to take into account the magnitude of the uncertainty about particular systems. One alternative approach to precautionary management is robust control, in which decision makers attempt to maximize an outcome under the assumption that the conditions will be worse than expected. In this paper, we apply a robust optimization approach to estimate the maximum sustainable yield and other reference points for the Chesapeake Bay blue crab Callinectes sapidus fishery. This approach is relatively easy to implement in standard stock assessment models that use a maximum-likelihood approach to estimate model parameters. In addition, it has the advantage that a standard level of precaution can be chosen by decision makers and then applied to different fisheries with vastly different levels of data and analysis.
abstract_zh: 大多数为渔业管理建立审慎指导原则的努力，实质上依赖于对何为保守管理的临时性印象。然而，这类方法未能考虑特定系统中不确定性的程度。稳健控制是审慎管理的一种替代方法，在这种方法中，决策者在假设条件将比预期更差的前提下，努力使结果最大化。本文运用稳健优化方法，估算切萨皮克湾蓝蟹（Callinectes sapidus）渔业的最大可持续产量及其他参考点。该方法易于在使用最大似然法估计模型参数的标准资源评估模型中实施。此外，它的优势在于，决策者可以选定一个标准的审慎水平，并将其应用于数据和分析水平大相径庭的不同渔业。

title: A coupled recreational anglers' decision and fish population dynamics model
Evaluating the efficacy of an information-based residential outdoor water conservation program
An Ex-Post Evaluation of Agricultural Extension Programs for Reducing Fertilizer Input in Shaanxi, China
abstract: It is difficult to control agricultural Non-point Source (NPS) pollution, caused by overusing of chemical fertilizer, through laws alone. An agricultural extension program is an alternative way to reduce fertilizer input. This paper estimates the average change in fertilizer use of farmers, which is attributable to their participation in the agricultural extension program. The Inverse-Probability Weighted matching method is used to evaluate the average treatment effect for the farmers who engaged in the program and, to a limited extent, evaluate the impact of individual elements of the program. Surprisingly, we find that farmer-to-farmer training may have had a counterproductive effect while the posters may be the most effective program element in reducing fertilizer use in the context.
abstract_zh: 仅靠法律难以控制由化肥过度使用所引起的农业非点源（NPS）污染。农业推广计划是减少化肥投入的另一种途径。本文估计了农民因参与农业推广计划而导致的化肥使用量的平均变化。我们采用逆概率加权匹配方法，评估参与该计划农民的平均处理效应，并在一定程度上评估计划各组成要素的影响。令人惊讶的是，我们发现农户之间的相互培训可能产生了适得其反的效果，而宣传海报可能是该背景下减少化肥使用最有效的计划要素。

title: Additionality and Reverse Crowding Out for Pollution Offsets in Water Quality Trading
Price Interaction in State Level Renewable Energy Credit Trading Programs
Management Evaluation for the Chesapeake Bay Blue Crab Fishery: An Integrated Bioeconomic Approach
venue: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
abstract:
We integrated two existing biological models and a newly developed economic demand model to evaluate the biological and economic performance of alternative policies in the Chesapeake Bay blue crab Callinectes sapidus fishery subject to the requirement that yield and revenue be sustainable. The resulting model was able to compare outcomes of alternative management scenarios considered by policy makers. In order to provide insights into the impacts of relevant policy components in a management scenario, we regressed the sustainable outcomes, sustainable yield, and sustainable revenues on a set of policy components. A short fishing season for female crabs combined with a long fishing season for males appeared to increase sustainable yield and revenue. Among size limit policies, lower minimum limits for males, females, peelers, and soft-shell crabs appeared to reduce sustainable outcomes, while a restrictive maximum size limit for mature females seemed to improve fishery performance with respect to both sustainable revenue and sustainable yield.
Received December 18, 2013; accepted November 4, 2014
abstract_zh:
我们整合了两个现有的生物学模型和一个新开发的经济需求模型，以评估切萨皮克湾蓝蟹（Callinectes sapidus）渔业在产量与收入须具可持续性这一要求下，各项替代政策的生物与经济绩效。所得模型能够比较政策制定者所考虑的各种管理情景的结果。为深入了解某一管理情景中各项相关政策组成部分的影响，我们将可持续产出、可持续产量和可持续收入对一组政策组成部分进行了回归。研究发现，雌蟹短暂的捕捞季节与雄蟹较长的捕捞季节相结合，似乎能够提高可持续产量和收入。在体型限制政策中，雄蟹、雌蟹、蜕壳蟹和软壳蟹的最低体型限制若降低，似乎会减少可持续产出；而针对成熟雌蟹的严格最大体型限制，似乎能够改善渔业在可持续收入和可持续产量两方面的表现。
收稿日期：2013年12月18日；接受日期：2014年11月4日

title: Measuring the potential for self-governance: an approach for the community-based management of the common-pool resources
Market-Based Conservation: Aligning Static Theory with Dynamic Systems
Practical Precautionary Resource Management Using Robust Optimization
Propuesta Metodologica Para Medir El Potencial De Autogobierno (A methodological proposal for measuring the potential for self governance)
Additionality and the Adoption of Farm Conservation Practices
abstract: We use propensity score matching to estimate additionality from enrollment in federal costshare programs for six practices. We analyze farmer adoption decisions based on farmer survey data in Ohio. We develop a new methodological approach to decompose the average treatment effect on the treated according to relative contributions of voluntary adopters and new adopters. Our results indicate that cost-share programs achieve positive levels of additionality for each practice. But percent additionality varies dramatically between practices. Specifically, percent additionality is highest for hayfield establishment (93.3%), cover crops (90.6%), and filter strips (88.9%), while it is lowest for conservation tillage (19.3%). (JEL Q24, Q28)
abstract_zh: 我们使用倾向得分匹配法，估计六项措施参与联邦成本分摊计划所产生的额外性（additionality）。我们基于俄亥俄州的农户调查数据分析农户的采用决策。我们提出了一种新的方法，依据自愿采用者与新采用者的相对贡献，对被处理者平均处理效应进行分解。结果表明，成本分摊计划对每项措施都产生了正向的额外性水平，但额外性百分比在不同措施之间差异很大。具体而言，干草地建立（93.3%）、覆盖作物（90.6%）和植被缓冲带（filter strips，88.9%）的额外性百分比最高，而保护性耕作（conservation tillage）最低，仅为19.3%。（JEL Q24, Q28）

title: Sequential License Buyback Auctions: An Experimental Analysis
User-Financing in a National Payments for Environmental Services Program: Costa Rican Hydropower
abstract: National government-funded payments for environmental services (PES) programs often lack sustainable financing and fail to target payments to providers of important environmental services. In principle, these problems can be mitigated by supplementing government financing with contributions from leading environmental service users. We use original survey data and official statistics to analyze user financing in Costa Rica’s renowned national PES program, focusing on the amounts and sources of user financing, the drivers of contributions, and contributors’ perceptions of the PES program. We find that user financing has supported less than three percent of the acres enrolled in the program and that hydroelectric plants are the largest private sector contributors. Large hydroelectric plants tend to contribute while small ones do not. The weight of evidence suggests that in addition to ensuring the provision of forest environmental services, hydroelectric plants’ motives for contributing to the PES program include improving relations with local communities and government regulators — common drivers of participation in all manner of voluntary environmental programs. These findings raise questions about the potential of user financing to improve the efficiency and financial sustainability of national PES programs.
abstract_zh: 由国家财政资助的生态服务付费（PES）计划往往缺乏可持续的融资渠道，且难以将支付精准地发放给重要生态服务的提供者。原则上，这些问题可以通过在政府融资之外，由主要生态服务使用者提供补充捐助来缓解。我们利用原始调查数据和官方统计资料，分析了哥斯达黎加享有盛誉的国家生态服务付费计划中的使用者融资情况，重点关注使用者融资的金额与来源、捐助行为的驱动因素，以及捐助者对该计划的看法。我们发现，使用者融资仅支持了该计划中不足3%的入组英亩数；水电站是最大的私营部门捐助者。大型水电站倾向于捐助，而小型水电站则不然。综合证据表明，除了确保森林环境服务的供给外，水电站参与捐助的动机还包括改善与当地社区和政府监管机构的关系，而这些正是各类自愿环境计划中普遍存在的参与驱动因素。这些发现引发了关于使用者融资能否提高国家生态服务付费计划效率与财务可持续性的疑问。

title: Changes in Subjective Risks of Hurricanes as Time Passes: Analysis of a Sample of Katrina Evacuees
abstract: Using a quasi‐field experiment, we report on subjects' perceptions of the risks of hurricanes. All experimental subjects were displaced by either Hurricane Katrina or Rita, in New Orleans and other Gulf Coast areas, except for a small control group consisting of people who live in central Texas. We examine their perceptions of risks just after the hurricanes occurred, and over one year later to evaluate the change in subjective risk perceptions over time. A latent risk model is estimated in which subjective probabilities of hurricane strike risk are represented as a function of respondents' demographic characteristics and experiences following the storms.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项准现场实验，报告了受试者对飓风风险的感知。所有实验对象都曾因卡特里娜飓风或丽塔飓风而流离失所，居住地为新奥尔良及墨西哥湾沿岸其他地区；仅有一小部分对照组，由居住于得克萨斯州中部的人员构成。我们考察了飓风发生后不久，以及一年多之后，受试者对风险的感知，以评估主观风险认知随时间的变化。我们估计了一个潜在风险模型，其中飓风登陆风险的主观概率被表示为受访者人口特征以及风暴过后经历的函数。

title: Explaining Subjective Risks of Hurricanes and the Role of Risks in Intended Moving and Location Choice Models
abstract: Using stated choice survey data we report on subjects’ perceptions of the risks of hurricanes and intended relocation decisions when faced with such risks. All of the subjects were displaced by either Hurricane Katrina or Rita, in New Orleans and other Gulf Coast areas in 2005. Results here suggest that subjective perceptions of risk are quite high as compared to scientific estimates of risk, and relocation decisions revealed from a discrete choice experiment are significantly determined by levels of hurricane strike risks.
abstract_zh: 利用选择实验调查数据，我们报告了受试者对飓风风险的感知，以及在面临此类风险时的意向性迁移和选址决策。所有受访者都曾在2005年因卡特里娜飓风或丽塔飓风而流离失所，居住地为新奥尔良及墨西哥湾沿岸其他地区。研究结果表明，与科学估计的风险相比，主观风险感知相当高，而且离散选择实验中所揭示的迁移决策，在很大程度上取决于飓风登陆风险的水平。

title: Meta-Functional Benefit Transfer for Wetland Valuation: Making the Most of Small Samples
Allocating Resources in an Uncertain World: Water Management and Endangered Species
abstract: Instream flows may be essential in protecting aquatic species that are threatened or endangered. An economic model of the optimal allocation of water under pure uncertainty is developed, with particular attention paid to the situation when a species characterized by critical depensation is affected by instream flows. We adopt the notion of pure uncertainty that Frank Knight and Daniel Ellsberg intended, which applies when decision makers cannot reduce their uncertainty to a unique probability distribution. Following recent work by Hansen, Sargent, and others, we employ robust control as a way to deal with this problem.
abstract_zh: 河流生态流量对于保护受威胁或濒危的水生物种可能至关重要。我们构建了一个在纯粹不确定性下水资源最优配置的经济模型，并特别关注受临界补偿（critical depensation）影响的物种受河流生态流量影响的情形。我们采用了弗兰克·奈特（Frank Knight）与丹尼尔·埃尔斯伯格（Daniel Ellsberg）所指的纯粹不确定性概念，即决策者无法将其不确定性归结为唯一概率分布的情形。沿循Hansen、Sargent等人的近期研究，我们运用稳健控制来处理这一问题。

title: NutrientNet: An Internet-based Approach to Teaching Market-Based Policy for Environmental Management
abstract: NutrientNet is an Internet-based environment in which a class can simulate a market-based approach for improving water quality. In NutrientNet, each student receives a role as either a point source or a nonpoint source polluter, and then the participants are allowed to trade water quality credits to cost-effectively reduce pollution in a watershed. The authors provide an overview of the content and structure of this Web site. They focus on the features that make NutrientNet an effective teaching tool for instructors and a rich learning environment for students.
abstract_zh: NutrientNet 是一个基于互联网的环境，课堂可借此模拟以市场为基础的水质改善方法。在 NutrientNet 中，每位学生分别扮演点源或非点源污染者的角色，随后参与者可以交易水质排放信用，以成本效益的方式减少流域内的污染。作者概述了该网站的内容与结构，并重点介绍了使 NutrientNet 成为教师有效教学工具、学生丰富学习环境的各项特色。

Sector-level Decisions in a Sustainability-constrained Economy
abstract: Despite two decades of debate, there remains little consensus about what sustainability is, and how it should be achieved. Economists primarily portray sustainability as a macro-level concern, but there has been less attention on the implications of this social objective for policies related to the management of individual resources. This paper derives guidance for sector-level planning and project analysis from a macro-level norm of intergenerational fairness. Optimal sustainable management involves making tradeoffs between sectors. We derive a criteria for sector-level planning and project analysis that help make those tradeoffs without losing site of the sustainability goal. (JEL Q30)
abstract_zh: 尽管经历了二十年的争论，人们对于何为可持续性以及如何实现可持续性，仍然缺乏共识。经济学家主要将可持续性视为宏观层面的问题，但较少关注这一社会目标对个别资源管理政策的影响。本文从代际公平这一宏观规范出发，为部门层面的规划与项目分析提供指导。最优的可持续管理涉及部门之间的权衡取舍。我们提出了部门层面规划与项目分析的标准，使得在做出这些权衡时不偏离可持续性目标。（JEL Q30）

title: Market Structures for U.S. Water Quality Trading
abstract: The use of transferable discharge permits as a water pollution control policy is rapidly increasing in the United States. Drawing on evidence from existing water quality trading programs, this paper provides a taxonomy of the forms that such markets take. Four main structures are identified: exchanges, bilateral negotiations, clearinghouses, and sole-source offsets. Each of these structures has its own strengths and weaknesses; none is optimal for all scenarios. Since market structure is largely determined by a program's rules, policy makers should be aware of the differences between these structures and the conditions under which each comes to be.
abstract_zh: 在美国，将可转让排放许可证用作水污染控制政策的做法正在迅速增加。本文借鉴现有水质交易项目的经验证据，对此类市场可能采取的形式进行了分类。文章识别出四种主要结构：交易所、双边协商、清算所和独家抵消。每种结构各有优劣，没有任何一种结构在所有情境下都是最优的。由于市场结构在很大程度上由项目规则决定，政策制定者应当了解这些结构之间的差异，以及每种结构形成所需的条件。

title: The Structure and Practice of Water-Quality Trading Markets
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: The use of transferable discharge permits in water pollution, what we will call water quality trading (WQT), is rapidly growing in the U.S. This paper reviews the current status of WQT nationally and discusses the structures of the markets that have been formed. Four main structures are observed in such markets: exchanges, bilateral negotiations, clearinghouses, and sole source offsets. The goals of a WQT program are environmental quality and cost effectiveness. In designing a WQT market, policy makers are constrained by legal restrictions and the physical characteristics of the pollution problem. The choices that must be made include how trading will be authorized, monitored and enforced. How these questions are answered will help determine both the extent to which these goals are achieved, and the market structures that can arise. After discussing the characteristics of different market structures, we evaluate how this framework applies in the case of California's Grassland Drainage Area Tradable Loads Program.
abstract_zh: 在水污染控制中使用可转让排放许可证，即我们所称的水质交易（WQT），在美国正迅速发展。本文回顾了全国水质交易的现状，并讨论了已经形成的市场结构。在此类市场中观察到四种主要结构：交易所、双边协商、清算所和独家抵消。水质交易项目的目标是环境质量和成本效益。在设计水质交易市场时，政策制定者受到法律限制以及污染问题物理特征的约束。必须作出的选择包括交易如何获得授权、如何监测以及如何执行。这些问题的答案将决定这些目标在多大程度上得以实现，以及可能出现哪些市场结构。在讨论了不同市场结构的特征之后，我们评估了该框架在加州草地排水区可交易负荷计划（Grassland Drainage Area Tradable Loads Program）中的适用情况。

Sustainability as Intergenerational Fairness: Efficiency, Uncertainty and Numerical Methods
abstract: This paper presents an economic model of sustainability defined as intergenerational fairness. Assuming that intergenerational fairness is an obligation of each generation, a recursive optimization problem is obtained. The problem has the advantage that uncertainty can readily be incorporated in the model and it can be solved numerically for a wide range of specifications. The possibility of trade‐offs between efficiency and sustainability are discussed. Under plausible conditions, it is shown that a sustainability obligation is met only if there is the expectation of economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个以代际公平定义可持续性的经济模型。假设代际公平是每一代人的义务，我们得到了一个递归优化问题。该问题的优势在于，不确定性可以很容易地纳入模型中，并且可以在广泛的设定条件下进行数值求解。文中讨论了效率与可持续性之间权衡取舍的可能性。在合理的条件下，研究表明，只有在经济增长的预期存在时，可持续性义务才能得到履行。
